suggestions.assertion: 대화에 재검토 조건이 없는 'API 키 발급' 대안에 Recheck if 조건을 지어내 넣지 않았다(줄 생략, Recheck if가 하나도 없으면 Review Trigger도 없음)
suggestions.reason: The assertion only checks the ADR file. This run kept the file clean but then asked the user in the reply — "'이런 조건이면 API 키 방식을 다시 본다' 같은 기준이 있으면 알려주세요, 추가하겠습니다" — which is exactly what the current skill added a rule against ("사용자에게 재검토 조건을 알려달라고 되묻지 않는다"). The new-skill run does not ask. This is the clearest behavioral difference between the two configurations and no assertion catches it; consider adding one scoped to the response.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are mostly discriminating, but on this eval all nine pass for both skill versions, so the suite does not currently separate v11 from the current skill. The recheck-condition follow-up question is the one observable divergence and is uncovered.
